inputs.original_text: Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday to protest the far-right, six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations and weeks ahead of key local elections. Organised by hundreds of groups, including trade unions, anti-racism campaigners and Muslim representative bodies, the Together Alliance event was billed as the biggest [...] The post Protesters rally in London against UK far-right rise appeared first on Digital Journal .
inputs.modified_text: Well, folks, once again we see the radical left and their institutional allies—trade unions, anti-racism campaigners, and Muslim representative bodies—mobilizing in the streets of central London. Tens of thousands of people marched through central London Saturday for this so-called Together Alliance event, billed as the biggest [...] just weeks ahead of key local elections. This comes six months after Britain saw one of its largest-ever far-right demonstrations. It is just another clear attempt by progressive agitators to disrupt our traditional social order, undermine our national heritage, and bully the British public right before they head to the ballot box. Instead of promoting personal responsibility and preserving our time-tested British values, these groups are manufacturing division and pandering to special interests to seize political power. We must stand firm for cultural continuity and law and order against this constant pressure from the radical mob.
